threshold_sources.strict_and_domain: historical controlled 80M reference retained until a larger baseline panel is frozen
threshold_sources.mcq_accuracy_min: business minimum above four-choice random performance
threshold_sources.mcq_wilson_lower_bound_min: statistical lower bound must exceed the four-choice random baseline
threshold_sources.mcq_instrument_limitation: The 2026-07-20 maintainer review of pretrain_mcq_benchmark_v2 found every sampled label correct but ruled the suite inadmissible as evidence of general capability, long-context capability or reasoning: 32 long_context records reduce to 4 templates, two category names do not describe what they measure, and weak distractors systematically overestimate the model. The MCQ thresholds are kept unchanged and still block, but a passing MCQ result is a pipeline-regression signal, not a capability claim. See configs/evaluation/pretrain_mcq_benchmark_v2.review.json.
